answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 41601 Country: India Title: TAFSEER IBNE KASEER Question: I want to know about the tafseer book ‘Tafseer Ibne Kaseer’. Can I study the book? Answer ID: 41601 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 891/890/N=1433) Tafseer Ibn Kathir is very authentic and reliable Tafseer. But you should study it under the supervision of any expert and competent Alim so that he could make clarifications at places where you could not understand the complete meaning. Also, you should not explain any verse from your own side without Shariah evidence. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
